ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to the foundations of interdisciplinary social science research. Topics include understanding the purpose for research, identifying researchable issues, finding, evaluating and using sources effectively, recognizing methods associated with different types of data and disciplines, and writing a literature review. Prepares students for course-based research papers and advanced research methods courses. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria in Summer 2021 for: • Quantitative Reasoning II • Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci
